verdict.rationale: Brex's marketing states it offers "AI-powered automation of invoice entry, approval, and payments," which matches AI reading bills and pre-filling payment details for approval. Bill pay is part of the unified platform, and the MCP server can track bills. The evidence, however, is a single marketing line with no detail on how extraction works or how review happens. Missing for 10: documentation of bill/invoice parsing and which payment fields are auto-populated, a described human-review step before payment, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
